title: North Potable Water Off Wednesday Morning July 8th
summary: Dear Residents, Please be advised that potable water service will be temporarily shut off in the North section of the community on July 8, 2026, at 9:00am to 11:00am for approximately 2 hours. This shut off is being completed at the request of a resident, with approval from park management, to address necessary maintenance.
